title: Open-LLM-VTuber: Talk to an AI with a Live2D Avatar (Offline)
description:
Open-LLM-VTuber is a free open-source tool that lets you have real-time voice conversations with an AI companion that appears as a Live2D avatar on your screen. It supports visual perception, voice interruption, and runs completely offline.
